debug.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting

log_file.description: Path to log file; empty disables file logging

auto_update.description: Update behavior: none disables updates, check only warns, download installs automatically

theme.description: Theme name (system/light/dark) or path to custom theme file

cache_dir.description: Custom cache directory path; empty uses system default

max_cache_size.description: Maximum cache size in MB (0 = unlimited)

show_read_receipts.description: Show small checkmarks indicating read receipts

room_sort_order.description: How to sort the room list in the sidebar

show_hidden_events.description: Show technical events (e.g., encryption changes) in chat history

enable_notifications.description: Enable desktop notifications for incoming messages

sound_on_message.description: Play sound when receiving a new message

notification_sound.description: Path to custom sound file; empty uses system default

notification_timeout.description: How many seconds notifications stay visible (0 = permanent)

show_message_preview.description: Include message content in notification popups

highlight_mentions.description: Highlight messages that mention the current user or @room

media_proxy_host.description: Proxy hostname (required if proxy type is manual)

media_proxy_port.description: Proxy port (required if proxy type is manual)

use_system_proxy.description: Use system-wide proxy settings for all network requests

homeserver.description: Base URL of your homeserver (e.g., https://matrix.example.com)

is_default.description: Mark this server as primary for new rooms

auto_join_rooms.description: List of room aliases or IDs to auto-join on login

servers.description: List of Matrix servers to connect to (supports multiple accounts)

use_system_font.description: Use system monospace font for messages

font_family.description: Custom font family for message display
